title: Foreign Bodies
full_summary: If you've ever gotten a splinter or had sand in your eye, you've had experience with a foreign body . A foreign body is something that is stuck inside you but isn't supposed to be there. You may inhale or swallow a foreign body , or you may get one from an injury to almost any part of your body . Foreign bodies are more common in small children, who sometimes stick things in their mouths, ears, and noses. Some foreign bodies , like a small splinter, do not cause serious harm. Inhaled or swallowed foreign bodies may cause choking or bowel obstruction and may require medical care.
